subject: util/rowcodec,tablecodec: remove `stmtctx` dependency from `rowcodec` and `tablecodec` (#48816)
summary: Reviewed this commit’s first-parent diff focusing on row encoding/key encoding and SQL-mode error handling fallout. The change cleanly replaces `*stmtctx.StatementContext` with `*time.Location` in `rowcodec`/`tablecodec` and moves SQL-mode handling to callers via `StatementContext.HandleError`; updated call sites in executor/table/statistics/store consistently pass non-nil timezones and handle returned (possibly grouped) errors. `errctx.Context.HandleError` now supports `errors.ErrorGroup`, matching the new multi-error behavior from `rowcodec`.
